visualCharacteristics: Labelled form fields with placeholders and inline error messages, submit button and an error notification row; submit is disabled (no backend).
contentPattern: One row per field (label, placeholder + error text, field type word), then a submit row and an error-notification row.
usage: Contact / newsletter / 'bring Fairtrade to your market' forms.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for simple field-list forms; wiring a real submission backend is separate work.
